A repair-worker analogy separates a reduced call for help from a worker remaining in a doorway; proteins and medicines have no purpose, and the cell has more than one response route.

before.supportingExcerpt: A DNA-associated protein obstacle can challenge copying without every encounter becoming a measured collision, double-strand break or cell death.
